name: Rocky Reach
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Warm days and cool nights keep acid and sugar in balance, and the long season lets tannins mature.

blurb.text: A strip of land along the Columbia River in central Washington, between Chelan and Wenatchee, entirely within the Columbia Valley AVA. The name comes from a rocky stretch of river rapids.
